article_ai_tokens.summary: A chatbot does not read your message; it reads tokens, and the limits on how many tokens it can hold explain most of what feels strange about it. After reading this you can explain what a token is, judge whether a message will fit in the context window, count tokens roughly, write prompts that get better answers, and recognise the moment a long chat has stopped being reliable.
article_ai_tokens.title: Understanding AI Tokens and How Chatbots Work

article_where_milk_comes_from.summary: Milk starts on a farm, inside a cow. After reading this you can tell your family where milk comes from, name the parts of a dairy, and choose a kind of milk at the shop.
article_where_milk_comes_from.title: Where Does Milk Come From?
